public_behavior: The adapter preserves scoped schema-version UUIDs, positive numeric versions, service lifecycle states, exact-definition duplicates, and unknown outcomes after registration; it never upgrades pending or unknown evidence to success.
Glue frames use header version byte three, compression byte zero, a 16-byte schema-version UUID, and payload; ZLIB byte five is recognized and explicitly unsupported.

Candidate compatibility checks, references, listing, and deletion are unsupported; faithful SDK exchanges are required local evidence, while credentialed live latest/by-ID/idempotent lookup remains optional and separately reported.
